# Synthetic fixtures

Only synthetic or irreversibly anonymized health documents may be committed.

Mandatory fixtures:
- prescription + invoice for the same MedicalEvent;
- report + prescription + multiple invoices;
- receipt fiscal code differs from clinical patient;
- mixed pharmacy receipt split across family members;
- physiotherapy cycle with one prescription and many invoices;
- private visit without traceable payment proof;
- explicit different-patient negative match.
